run_release_docs: run the release_docs.py script with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_wiki_brancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare branching of wiki files for a release
branch_wiki_files: branch wiki files using svn cp to create versioned copies like V2_6_FAQ.wiki from FAQ.wiki
update_links_in_branched_files: update internal wiki links in branched files so they point to the versioned page names
drop_wiki_suffix: remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename using the DropWikiSuffix helper function
